name: Kópháza (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue in the ratio 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kópháza: a quartered shield of white, red and green with a swan, a church, a Croatian checky and a Hungarian shield.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
